name: New Mexico Agricultural Education and FFA Association
what_you_do: Join FFA through your school's ag program. The site lists career development events, a leadership camp and FFA Day at the Roundhouse.
who_can_apply: Students in New Mexico ag education programs. The association says it serves over 5,300 members in over 85 schools. No age or grade rule is stated.
pay_detail: Leadership Camp fee is $225 per camper for June 22 to 25, 2027. Register by May 19, 2027. Camp scholarships are offered.
duration: School year. Leadership Camp is a separate event.
deadline_text: Join through your school's ag program.
how_to_apply: The site lists FFA chapter lists, a 2026-2027 plan for events, scholarships and Jr. High contests.
notes: The site footer still says 2022, so confirm camp details with your ag teacher or the state office.
